digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and Git protocol integration
propositions: Large partial-clone fixture (>100MiB object) is duplicated per xdist worker, consuming ~32.69 worker-phase seconds; optimization requires splitting into size-dependent large guards and size-independent small protocol fixtures.
Three filter-negotiation, two identity-lane, and reconvergence/push test cases are provably size-independent and can be migrated to isolated 1 KiB ephemeral servers without loss of protocol coverage.
Exact-defect mutation (replacing 1 KiB payload with 141 MiB) must cause held-out pack oracle to fail at >140 MiB threshold, proving small fixtures detect genuine protocol defects.
Each worker must own separate ephemeral loopback daemon, temporary repositories, and object database; no mutable Git server or state is shared across concurrent workers.
Wall-clock savings target pytest wall 69.5%, real wall 78.5%, setup 85.2%, and aggregate CPU 80.8% versus baseline.
